note: Placement of the approved epic_smg hip image (Stage 38, registered by AssetPipeline; read by PixelWeaponArt through its WeaponArtDefinition). Image 1774x887 (Stage 38 spec 4, provisional standard), pixel coordinates from the top-left. muzzle = centre of the muzzle device's front (outline x 940); hold = the right hand on the pistol grip. The emission core and glow images share this canvas and pivot, read from the image. The other values are the approved rifle hip's (same dot size, 1045 px per screen height; image bottom-right on the screen's bottom-right lowered by 0.05, right-edge follow on wider screens, 4:3 keeps the place, hip -> ADS straight down). Written by hand. 2026-11-06 (Stage 38 aim fix): offset moved from [0, -0.05] to [0.1142, 0.0491] so the muzzle sits on screen where the rifle's does (canvas (1074, 389) at the rifle's anchoring; this image's muzzle (946, 500) is 128 px left and 111 px lower): the shots then leave the lower right toward the crosshair as the rifle's, instead of almost straight up. The clear zone stays empty (nearest drawn pixel 237-240 px from the centre points) and the cut edges stay off screen. The image is unchanged. 2026-11-06 (flash): the barrel is drawn near level, so a flash centred on the muzzle in front of the gun covered the barrel; it is drawn behind the gun (hipMuzzleFlashBehind) and centred 16 px beyond the muzzle along the barrel (hipMuzzleFlashOffset, image pixels): it bursts out of the muzzle without painting over the gun. The rifle and SMG keep theirs. 2026-11-06 (barrel angle): the barrel is drawn flatter than the line from the muzzle to the crosshair (barrel about 8 deg in the image, the line about 30.6 deg on the iPhone), so the shots seemed to leave at another angle than the barrel points. The image is turned 16 deg clockwise around the hold (hipRoll -16) and the offset moved from [0.1142, 0.0491] to [0.16, -0.0536]: on the iPhone the barrel is at 24 deg and the line at 28 deg, the muzzle on the barrel's line toward the crosshair; no cut edge comes on any screen at rest, mid-reload or kicked (the bottom-left arm rises when turned, so the gun sits further into the corner), and about as much of the gun shows as the rifle's. The image pixels are unchanged (the sprite is turned when drawn). 2026-11-06 (glow): the glow layer is mostly transparent (alpha up to 37/255) and was painted over the gun with the normal blend, so it hardly showed; it is now added (glowAdditive, Deadlock/Sprite Additive Glow, gain glowGain) and pulses slowly (glowPulse share, glowPulseSeconds). The emission core is drawn as before. 2026-11-06 (flash from the bore): the flash was the round star centred 16 px beyond the muzzle and 3 px up (hipMuzzleFlashOffset [-16, -3]); behind the gun only its part over the gun was hidden, so its rays stood out above and around the muzzle instead of coming out of it. It is now a jet out of the bore along the drawn barrel: hipMuzzleFlashRoot [941, 503] = the centre of the bore opening (front of the outline, middle of the face; measured), hipMuzzleFlashBarrel 8.0 = the drawn barrel's angle above the left horizontal, hipMuzzleFlashReach 12 = the jet's centre 12 px beyond the bore, hipMuzzleFlashStretch [0.7, 0.35] = along / across the barrel. Still behind the gun (its back half and root are hidden in the muzzle). It turns with the image (hipRoll), so it stays on the barrel's line on every screen and pose. 2026-11-06 (glow breathing): on the iPhone the glow was too weak for an EPIC gun. The glow image is very faint (alpha 8/255 on average, most pixels 1-13/255, never outside the gun or on the core), so gain 4.5 added little light, and the pulse only dipped it by 25 percent while the core stayed steady. Now the core and the glow breathe together over glowPulseSeconds 2.4 (smooth cosine, no steps), each by its own depth: the core (normal blend, the pixels keep their outlines) 100 percent down to 30 percent (emissionPulse 0.7; at its lowest the darker painted lights of the hip image show through, close to a plain SMG), the glow 100 percent down to 10 percent (glowPulse 0.9, nearly gone), with glowGain 14 so its spread around the lines, screws, core and green sight shows clearly at the top (compared at 4.5 / 6 / 10 / 14 / 18 on dark and bright backgrounds; 18 smeared the thin lines). The images are unchanged. 2026-11-07 (flash order): every gun's hip and ADS flash is now drawn behind its gun image (one rule in WeaponViewPresenter), so hipMuzzleFlashBehind is gone; this flash was already behind, nothing changes for it.
